message.content: {"evidence":"Original N curve shows a sustained ~2–3 mm elevated platform from index ~498 to ~542, then a drop back toward the pre-498 trend; E and U show no matching coherent offset-return pattern—E has noise/spikes, U is noisy with no clear platform. Only N supports a temporary level shift with return, but the pair R1 spans the entire interval and the drop at 542 appears abrupt without clear rejoining of the prior trajectory; residual panels show the step is mostly removed by reference, suggesting it may be part of the long-term trend rather than a true temporary offset. No pair satisfies the requirement of an observed elevated platform that returns toward the continuing local trajectory while allowing underlying gradual displacement.","pair_ids":[]}
